target_profile.scope: Native Apple-silicon macOS binaries, including required public and Apple-specific extensions and ABI behavior; host extensions selected by explicit capability checks.
target_profile.inventory_limits: Reviewed shared A64 forms only. This list is not a complete Apple CPU feature contract, private-extension inventory, or binary-compatibility denominator.

instruction_sources.redistribution_scope: Only factual identifiers, names, categorical/feature metadata and fixed encoding bits are included. Arm XML, authored instruction prose and pseudocode remain local and are not redistributed.

profile.description: Uniform fixed SME2 guest execution profile with explicit streaming length and initial SM/ZA state; host capability selection is separate. Every form sample declares its own SVL and SVCR.
outside_scope: Apple hardware conformance, applications and macOS boot

forms.scope: Complete allocated standalone streaming Boolean, unary, selection, copy and cross-half form under fixed SME2 profile, all five supported SVLs. Source operands snapshot before writes; first element predicate bits govern merging/zeroing; aliases retain original values. Preserves unrelated primary state, predicates, SVCR/TPIDR2, ZA/ZT0, FPCR/FPSR/NZCV and RAM. Both MOVPRFX forms and execution as their successor are excluded; no paired-prefix claim. FFR/FPMR preservation is diagnostic only. Historical full-state original/model/native evidence transfers through fresh exact current-library body/maps, without semantic replay. Raw context leaf only; no block/cache, disabled-access traps, Apple hardware or application/macOS claim.
forms.review: Consolidated Boolean/copy mapping and isolated full-state original/model/native evidence; actual frozen-library full body/map preservation links the selected recipe to the context leaf.

Pinned June allocation/mode review, controlled per-instruction mapping comparisons and genuine same-input original/native full observed state. Production parent integration validates exact instruction bodies, wrapper/source-map partition, aliases, all supported vector lengths and reserved/mode declines. Independent source/mapping review retained. MOVPRFX pairs remain a separate explicit decline.
forms.scope: Declared SME2 guest execution profile, SME enabled and SM=1, power-of-two streaming vector length16..256 bytes; M4/M5 candidate membership only. All allocated element widths and register/immediate aliases; merging predicates select each element-leading bit. Updates exactly destination Z, preserving other Z/P, primary GPR/SP/NZCV/FPCR/FPSR, ZA/ZT0, SVCR and TPIDR2. Register-only operation has no guest RAM access. FFR/FPMR have no original observation credit. No general non-streaming SVE, Apple hardware conformance, production block/cache context entry, full guest exception delivery, application or macOS claim.

forms.scope:
Scalar streaming integer reductions admit ANDV, EORV, ORV, SADDV, UADDV,
SMAXV, SMINV, UMAXV and UMINV at all 35 allocated widths. SADDV accepts B/H/S;
its D encoding is reserved. UADDV accepts B/H/S/D. Governing P0–P7 selects
elements using their first predicate bit. Empty predicates return the operation
identity: all ones for AND/unsigned minimum, signed minimum for signed maximum,
signed maximum for signed minimum, and zero for OR/XOR/add/unsigned maximum.
Signed sums sign-extend each active element and both sums wrap modulo 64 bits.
Other results retain the element width. V destination writes clear all current
Z bits above the result; aliases read every source chunk before the first write.
GPRs, NZCV, FP storage, predicates, ZA, ZT0, SVCR and TPIDR2 are preserved.
These forms require declared SME and SM=1, independently of ZA, in the fixed
SVL16/32/64/128/256 context profile. Quadword reductions require their separate
declared-SME2p1 admission and evidence group; BASE9 confers no Q support. V1 and
V2 without SME2p1 explicitly reject all eight Q forms. Generic typed reduction
decoding owns this distinction. Original FFR/FPMR observation,
MOVPRFX pairing and scalable runtime cache execution remain outside this cohort.

The canonical successor CLI retains these through 1,050 exact body and 669 whole-program byte bridges; zero new native/original executions. BASE9 only; Q16 owns declared-SME2p1 positives. Original FFR/FPMR, scalable runtime caching, MOVPRFX pairs, applications and macOS remain unverified. Individual-instruction timing only.

forms.scope:
Scalar streaming integer reductions admit ANDV, EORV, ORV, SADDV, UADDV,
SMAXV, SMINV, UMAXV and UMINV at all 35 allocated widths. SADDV accepts B/H/S;
its D encoding is reserved. UADDV accepts B/H/S/D. Governing P0–P7 selects
elements using their first predicate bit. Empty predicates return the operation
identity: all ones for AND/unsigned minimum, signed minimum for signed maximum,
signed maximum for signed minimum, and zero for OR/XOR/add/unsigned maximum.
Signed sums sign-extend each active element and both sums wrap modulo 64 bits.
Other results retain the element width. V destination writes clear all current
Z bits above the result; aliases read every source chunk before the first write.
GPRs, NZCV, FP storage, predicates, ZA, ZT0, SVCR and TPIDR2 are preserved.
These forms require declared SME and SM=1, independently of ZA, in the fixed
SVL16/32/64/128/256 context profile. Quadword reductions require their separate
declared-SME2p1 admission and evidence group; BASE9 confers no Q support. V1 and
V2 without SME2p1 explicitly reject all eight Q forms. Generic typed reduction
decoding owns this distinction. Original FFR/FPMR observation,
MOVPRFX pairing and scalable runtime cache execution remain outside this cohort.

forms.scope:
SME2p1 streaming Q16 comprises DUPQ, EXTQ, TBLQ, TBXQ, ZIPQ1/2,
UZPQ1/2 and ADDQV, ANDQV, EORQV, ORQV, SMAXQV, SMINQV, UMAXQV, UMINQV.
The shared typed SME2p1 requirement and streaming guard admit only an explicit
V2 SME/SME2/SME2p1 declaration at SVL16/32/64/128/256, independently of ZA.
The chosen V2 specialization carries DIT=0, maximum SVL and ZT0 permission as
immutable profile/manifest identity; this is no blanket architectural DIT rule
for the sixteen instructions. Only a selected scalar TBLQ/TBXQ gather needs the
additional explicit-DIT0 recipe guard. Checked SSSE3 byte PSHUFB has no added
DIT restriction. Other Q forms receive no table-recipe guard. This is the SME-
derived streaming alternative, not general SVE2p1 or a hardware feature capture.
Rearrangements preserve architectural segment/index/alias semantics. Quadword
reductions combine matching element positions across 128-bit chunks, apply the
operation identity to inactive positions and clear current Z bits above the low
128-bit result. ADDQV wraps at element width. All source aliases are read before
writeback. GPRs, NZCV, FP storage, predicates, ZA, ZT0, SVCR and TPIDR2 survive.
Original FFR/FPMR and DIT readback are unobserved; runtime scalable cache execution,
MOVPRFX pairs, resumable faults, applications and macOS boot remain unverified.

The chosen V2 specialization carries DIT=0, maximum SVL and ZT0 permission as
immutable profile/manifest identity; this is no blanket architectural DIT rule
for the sixteen instructions. Only a selected scalar TBLQ/TBXQ gather needs the
additional explicit-DIT0 recipe guard. Checked SSSE3 byte PSHUFB has no added
DIT restriction. Other Q forms receive no table-recipe guard. This is the SME-
derived streaming alternative, not general SVE2p1 or a hardware feature capture.
Rearrangements preserve architectural segment/index/alias semantics. Quadword
reductions combine matching element positions across 128-bit chunks, apply the
operation identity to inactive positions and clear current Z bits above the low
128-bit result. ADDQV wraps at element width. All source aliases are read before
writeback. GPRs, NZCV, FP storage, predicates, ZA, ZT0, SVCR and TPIDR2 survive.
Original FFR/FPMR and DIT readback are unobserved; runtime scalable cache execution,
MOVPRFX pairs, resumable faults, applications and macOS boot remain unverified.
